overview_description.description: Insyab’s mission to offer wireless solutions that unleash the power of collaboration. They believe the next wave of use cases in the robotics industry entails the deployment of multiple agents (e.g. drones, crawlers, or rovers) which cooperate together to finish the job faster and more efficiently. The same concept can be generalized to any multi-agent autonomous system. In a number of key market segments, such as law enforcement and energy, missions have to be carried out independent of cellular infrastructire. This calls for a robust stand-alone wireless connectivity solution.
